description: This Java class 'HelloWorldTask' implements a scheduled task within the OpenMRS framework that logs 'Hello World' messages upon creation, execution, and shutdown. It extends 'AbstractTask' and utilizes SLF4J for logging.

classes.name: HelloWorldTask
classes.description: A scheduled task that logs 'Hello World' messages during its lifecycle, extending 'AbstractTask'.

methods.name: HelloWorldTask
methods.description: Constructor that logs the creation time of the task.

methods.name: execute
methods.description: Method that gets called to perform the task, logs execution, and marks start of execution.

methods.name: shutdown
methods.description: Method that gets called to shutdown the task, logs shutdown, and marks stop of execution.
